visualCharacteristics.purpose: Square photo cards with a name; a + button flips the card to show a bio
notes: Cream background; centred uppercase heading "GOALKEEPERS"; 3-up square player cards (photo with shirt number and flag, name and + button bottom-left); + flips the card to show a bio.

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: cell 1 = photo, cell 2 = name heading + bio paragraph(s) shown on the back
blockContent: 3 player flip cards, each photo + name (front) and bio paragraph (back), + button flips

usage.description: Player or team member cards with a short bio.

reuseGuidance: Use when each card needs hidden detail text. Use cards-people for linked directory entries.
